body.statement: Every member of \(\mathcal M_p\) has \(p+1\) distinct covariance matrices, and the pooled law \(P_{\mathrm{mix}}\) identifies the unordered covariance-weight pairs \(\{(\Sigma_c,\pi_c):c\in C\}\) up to permutation.
body.justification: This lemma closes the population passage from a pooled distribution to the unordered component tuple.
body.gap: Kumar, Shiragur, and Uhler identify general mixture parameters for fixed component count; this lemma isolates the exact population fact required when the causal labels are still hidden.
body.consumer: Theorem 1 can start from the pooled law rather than assuming that component covariances arrive with semantic labels.
